title: eval-harness: add per-prompt CI metrics hook and threshold gating
author: Morgan Lee
description: Introduce a per-prompt CI hook that runs eval-harness metrics on changed prompt-sets and fails PRs when agreed quality thresholds regress. Motivation: teams keep shipping prompt and dataset tweaks without per-prompt visibility; this adds a lightweight gate to catch prompt-specific regressions early. Changes include: a new CI workflow (.github/workflows/eval-ci.yml) that invokes the eval-harness in a per-prompt mode, a metrics integration library that computes per-prompt deltas and summary statistics, a small status poster to GitHub checks and Linear, and a YAML configuration for per-prompt thresholds (config/eval/prompt_thresholds.yaml). The hook is opt-in via CODEOWNERS-style files and can be toggled by repo-level config. Testing: unit tests for metric computation and end-to-end CI smoke test in tests/eval. Backwards compatibility: default thresholds are permissive; no effect unless the repo enables the hook. Checklist: - Add CI workflow and runner script - Add metrics delta computation and threshold config - Add unit + e2e tests - Add docs for enabling and tuning thresholds - Add simple migration guide for teams moving from global eval to per-prompt gating
